text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race was decided. 1st place—she had 
lost it. For the very first time, Admire 
Vega felt a swell of bitter frustration 
rising within her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, that very frustration becomes the 
driving force pushing her toward the next 
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next is the final leg of the Classic 
Triple Crown: the Kikuka Sho. After making 
that solemn vow with her rival――

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With excitement in their hearts, summer 
was just around the corner.
